Dear Tailspin Ltd,

This email confirms your request for a seat charge correction has been processed. Your refund of **$175** (for the erroneous seat overcharge) has been issued and should reflect in your account within **3-5 business days** via your original payment method.

**Updated Seat Count:** Your contract has been corrected to **40 seats** as of today.

If you have further questions or require assistance, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
